args.memo: March 2026 - Acme Logistics API usage overage billing
March 2026 - Beacon Health SLA credit (uptime 99.31% vs 99.5% threshold)

args.description: Corvid Retail requested $2,500 SLA credit on 2026-03-30 (DOC-0202). However, uptime was 99.94% which exceeds the 99.5% SLA threshold per contract (DOC-0001). Contract specifies 10% credit only if uptime falls below 99.5%. No credit is due. Customer request cannot be honored per contract terms.

args.text:
MARCH 2026 BILLING ADJUSTMENTS - US ENTITY - COMPLETION MEMO

COMPLETED TASKS:

1. USAGE OVERAGE BILLING
   - Acme Logistics: Billed $1,136 for API usage overage
     • Contract: 1,000,000 API calls included per month at $0.004 per overage call
     • March usage: 1,284,000 calls
     • Overage: 284,000 calls × $0.004 = $1,136
     • JE-00304 posted to AR/Usage Revenue, supported by DOC-0210 (usage report) and DOC-0003 (contract)
     • SLA status: 99.97% uptime exceeds 99.5% threshold - no SLA credit due

2. SLA CREDIT PROCESSING
   - Beacon Health: Issued $800 SLA credit
     • Contract: 99.5% SLA threshold, 10% monthly subscription credit if missed
